name: /artifacts
description: List accessible Claude artifacts and attach one to the session, open it in a browser, or copy its link.

examples.explanation: Open the picker and attach a shared architecture artifact as working context.

when_to_use: Use when an existing Claude artifact contains requirements or design material needed in the current session.

conditions: Available only where Claude artifacts are supported.
Requires Claude Code v2.1.208 or later; attaching with Enter requires v2.1.216 or later.

name: /auto-mode-setup
description: Draft autoMode.environment entries from the project and recent sessions, then review and save them to user settings.

examples.explanation: Draft and review environment restrictions before enabling auto mode.

when_to_use: Use to establish reviewed environment rules before relying on auto mode.
when_not_to_use: Do not accept the generated rules without reviewing their effect on commands and secrets.

conditions: Requires Claude Code v2.1.228 or later; native Windows requires v2.1.233 or later.

name: /autofix-pr
display_name: Watch and automatically fix a pull request
description: Start a Claude Code web session that watches the current branch's pull request and pushes fixes for CI failures or review comments.

examples.explanation: Watch the current branch's pull request using the default remediation prompt.

examples.command: /autofix-pr only fix lint and type errors
examples.explanation: Limit automatic fixes to lint and type-check failures.

when_to_use: Use when a checked-out branch has an open pull request that should be monitored for actionable failures or feedback.
when_not_to_use: Do not use until you are comfortable with a cloud session pushing changes to the pull-request branch.

conditions: Requires the gh CLI and access to Claude Code on the web.
The target pull request is detected from the checked-out branch.

name: /focus
description: Toggle a focused transcript view that shows the last prompt, compact tool summaries, and the final response.

examples.explanation: Reduce visual noise while following a long implementation turn with many tool calls.

when_to_use: Use when tool output makes the terminal transcript difficult to scan.

name: /heapdump
description: Write a JavaScript heap snapshot and a separate memory-diagnostics summary for troubleshooting high memory usage.

examples.explanation: Capture diagnostics after reproducing abnormal Claude Code memory growth.

when_to_use: Use only while diagnosing high Claude Code memory usage.
when_not_to_use: Do not share the .heapsnapshot file; official documentation warns that it contains the full conversation and credentials.

conditions: Hidden from the command menu and must be typed in full.

notes: Share only the generated -diagnostics.json file when reporting an issue.

name: /insights
description: Generate a local HTML report about recent projects, Claude Code usage patterns, failures, and features to consider.

examples.explanation: Generate a report to review recurring workflow friction across recent local sessions.

when_to_use: Use to identify patterns across recent local sessions rather than inspect one active conversation.

name: /list-agents
description: List subagents, agent-team teammates, and other Claude Code sessions that the current session can message.

examples.explanation: Find the exact recipient name before sending a cross-session coordination message.

when_to_use: Use before cross-session messaging when you need the exact available recipient names.

conditions: Requires cross-session messaging to be enabled.
Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later; teammate rows and the current session name require v2.1.239 or later.

name: /schedule
description: Create, update, list, run, or inspect routines that execute in the cloud through a conversational setup flow.

examples.command: /schedule run the dependency audit every Monday morning
examples.explanation: Begin configuring a recurring cloud routine.

when_to_use: Use for recurring tasks that should execute through Claude's cloud routine system.
when_not_to_use: Do not treat this as a local operating-system scheduler.

conditions: Requires access to Claude routines and cloud execution.

name: /setup-bedrock
description: Run an interactive wizard for Amazon Bedrock authentication, region, and model pins.

examples.explanation: Configure a workstation to use the organization's Bedrock region and approved models.

when_to_use: Use when Claude Code should authenticate and run through Amazon Bedrock.

conditions: Hidden from the command menu until CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 is set, though it can be typed in full.

name: /setup-vertex
description: Run an interactive wizard for Google Cloud authentication, project, region, and model pins.

examples.explanation: Configure a workstation for the organization's Google Cloud project and approved region.

when_to_use: Use when Claude Code should run through Google Cloud's Agent Platform.

conditions: Hidden from the command menu until CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1 is set, though it can be typed in full.

name: /tui
description: Show or change the terminal UI renderer and relaunch while preserving the conversation.

examples.explanation: Switch the active conversation to fullscreen rendering.

when_to_use: Use to opt into or leave the fullscreen terminal renderer without losing the conversation.

conditions: Fullscreen support depends on the terminal environment.

name: /voice
description: Toggle voice dictation or choose hold-to-talk, tap-to-toggle, or off behavior.

examples.explanation: Use hold-to-talk behavior for dictating a detailed implementation prompt.

when_to_use: Use when dictation is more convenient than typing a prompt.

conditions: Requires a Claude.ai account and an available input device.

name: /workflow-authoring
description: Load the bundled reference for dynamic workflow scripts, including the API, resume behavior, quality patterns, and examples.

examples.explanation: Load the reference before manually editing a saved dynamic workflow script.

when_to_use: Use before writing or manually modifying a dynamic workflow script.

conditions: Available only when dynamic workflows are enabled.
Requires Claude Code v2.1.248 or later.
